'''Fatalissar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He declared a [[Kaggath]] against his rival, [[Darth Tormen]], while within arm's reach of Tormen on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]; however, when Fatalissar decreed the domain of the Kaggath to be the planet's surface, Tormen decapitated him mid-sentence, winning the duel.<ref name="TOR Encyclopedia" />
